title: `SUM` of doubles: plain, order by partitioning
verdict: plain recursive summation; order depends on partitioning
description: `SUM(DOUBLE)` adds with a plain `Add` and no overflow check; partial sums merge plainly. The order of the additions depends on the partitioning.

The probes show the order at work: 1e16, 1, -1e16, 1 summed in input order on one partition is 0.0; after a shuffle into one partition 1.0, into three partitions 2.0. A `FLOAT` column sums in `DOUBLE` (`sum` returns `DOUBLE`). No values, or NULLs only, give NULL.
reference: `AggFn.fsum` (`floatSum`) adds the doubles one by one in list order from +0.0; the writers that need that order exactly use `Dialect.float_sum`. NULL without values.
